description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git status' command with filesystem watcher (fsmonitor). It contains setup functions, test cases, and assertions to verify the behavior of the fsmonitor extension in various scenarios including repository states, cache invalidations, and index behaviors.

methods.name: clean_repo
methods.description: Resets the repository to a clean state by discarding uncommitted changes and removing untracked files.

methods.name: dirty_repo
methods.description: Creates a dirty repository with modified, untracked, and new files for testing.

methods.name: write_integration_script
methods.description: Defines a setup script for fsmonitor integration testing by writing a script to a hook.

methods.name: check_sparse_index_behavior
methods.description: Verifies that 'git status' behaves correctly with sparse index, depending on whether full index is ensured.
